subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summary Milton was an English poet and a man of letters. His father’s support and encouragement always inspired him to be involved in literary work. This great poet had knowledge about Roman, Greek, Italian, French and Spanish literature and about the holy Bible. But this great poet became blind in 1652. The idea behind his world famous work "Paradise Lost" developed after his blindness. It was published in 1665. But this great poet died on November 8, 1674.
